text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: The Japanese Derby will soon be<n>upon us.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Today, the racers have been gathered<n>for a press
conference about the<n>challenge before them.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Ahahahah! What am I expectin' from<n>the Derby?
Do ya even have to ask?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Victory! Triumph! Conquest! What<n>else could there
be?!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Who's the world's strongest racer?!<n>The Derby is
where that question will<n>be answered!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Easy now, easy. Keep going on like<n>that and you'll
tire yourself out before<n>the race even starts.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Me, on the other hand, I'll be taking it<n>slow like
always.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
If you wanna know more, you'll just<n>have to check
out the main event.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: M-my m-motivation?! My motivation<n>is, um... um!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I-I want my moms and everyone back<n>home to, um,
see me become number<n>one in Japan, so... Umm...
I'll give it my all!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: El Condor Pasa... Seiun Sky... Special<n>Week...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
This year's Japanese Derby is<n>stacked with a
fearsome lineup of<n>racers—Umamusume who were
turning heads before they even<n>debuted.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
With precious little time remaining until<n>the big
event, the atmosphere among<n>the racers is electric,
and yet...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
My name is Grass Wonder. It's a<n>pleasure to
make your acquaintance.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Oh, she's here—the Beast's<n>Successor!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Excuse me! May I ask a question,<n>please?!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Go right ahead.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
After your impressive achievements<n>in your junior
year, there are a lot of<n>hopes riding on you. Are you
feeling<n>any of that pressure now?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Well, I would be lying to say I haven't<n>noticed the
pressure at all. However...

I will nonetheless face this challenge<n>with a clear
mind and steady<n>preparations. After all, luck favors
the<n>brave.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
And they do say the luckiest<n>Umamusume wins the
Japanese<n>Derby, yes?

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Wow, talk about having a cool head!<n>Next question...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for waiting, Trainer. I<n>finished the
interview without a hitch.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. As I still have plenty of energy<n>left, I'd like to
get right into some trai—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: GRAAAAASS! Stop, stop! Stop it right<n>there!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: The Phantom Bird appears outta the<n>void!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Oh... Is something the matter?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Nothin' much! Just droppin' by to<n>remind ya: This!
Is! War!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Over the top as usual, I see.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Didn't we both already voice our<n>ambitions in the
press conference?
Nuh-uh!

I heard you talkin', and it was a<n>bunch of
goodie-two-shoes baloney!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I know you've got more fire hidden<n>under the prim
little Nadeshiko act.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: So that's why I'm here to talk to thereal you, Grass!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
To tell you how super, mega, ultra<n>psyched I am to
face you, frente a<n>frente, in an all-out clash!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
The race to decide who is la primera!<n>Who is at the
top of the world! Here<n>we goooo!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: My, my.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Grass Wonder stands there silently<n>for a moment
before finally saying<n>with a gentle smile...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Consider it a match.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
That little run-in with El cost us time.<n>Shall we make
up for it, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Well, yes...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
After all, each Classic race is a<n>once-in-a-lifetime
opportunity.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
El, Sei, Spe... They're going to do<n>everything in their
power to emerge<n>victorious in this race.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: But I will not allow them to pass me.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
For a far greater shadow looms...<n>further down the
path I tread.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The seconds are ticking down to the<n>day of the
Japanese Derby.
